# BoredMutant

> BoredMutant builds AI order entry and order-to-cash software for wholesale distributors. Purchase orders that arrive by email, PDF, spreadsheet or WhatsApp are read, matched to the distributor's item numbers and entered into its ERP; quotes are priced, invoices sent and payments chased. Unclear lines go to a person with the question to resolve. Fixed prices, no per-seat fees, and the client owns the code. Based in Hyderabad; serves the United States and India.

Canonical URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/
India page (Tally and WhatsApp): https://www.boredmutant.com/india
Book a call: https://cal.com/boredmutant/automations

Full page text: https://www.boredmutant.com/llms-full.txt

## What it builds

- Order entry: emailed POs, PDFs and spreadsheets become sales orders in the ERP.
- Quoting: requests for quote priced from the distributor's price lists and history.
- Invoices and collections: invoices out on time, reminders that follow up, payments matched.
- Company brain: answers about stock, orders, prices and policy, with the source.

## ERPs it is built around

Epicor Prophet 21, Epicor Eclipse, Infor CloudSuite Distribution, NetSuite, Acumatica, SAP Business One, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Tally. Any ERP that accepts orders through an API, an import file or its database can be connected.

## How an engagement runs

- Audit, two weeks, fixed fee: sit with the people who enter orders, time every step, write a fixed-price spec with the payback.
- Build, three to six weeks, fixed price: connect the inbox and ERP, run on real orders beside the team, then switch on.
- Run, monthly, flat fee: watch every order, fix what breaks, ship small changes. The client can stop any month and keep the system.

## Terms

- The client owns the code and the data; the code lives in the client's repository.
- Prices are fixed and quoted before the client commits.
- No per-seat fees.
- A person approves anything the system is unsure about.
- The system runs in parallel with the team before it goes live.

## Who it is for

Wholesale distributors in the United States with roughly 50 to 500 staff, and distributors and manufacturers in India running on Tally and WhatsApp. The same approach applies to manufacturers, contractors, logistics and service firms whose work arrives as email and ends as data entry.

## Guides

- [Email order processing: why distributors still retype POs, and how to stop](https://www.boredmutant.com/blog/email-order-processing-for-distributors): Why distributors still retype emailed POs, the four ways to automate email order processing, how an email becomes an ERP sales order, and what retyping costs.
- [AI order entry for distributors: how it works, what it costs, and how to judge it](https://www.boredmutant.com/blog/ai-order-entry-for-distributors): A plain guide to AI order entry for wholesale distributors: how emailed POs become ERP sales orders, how to put a number on manual entry, buy vs build, and a 10-PO test to judge any vendor.
